features: Eye4spy USB Camera in a Charger – Looks like a regular USB charger but records 1080P HD video discreetly for home, office, or shop surveillance.
No Wi-Fi Needed – SD Card Recording Only – No app, no internet, no monthly fees. All videos are saved securely to an SD card (SD card not included in the package).
Dual Recording Modes – Continuous Mode (L): Records nonstop and auto-overwrites old files. Motion Detection Mode (M): Records only when movement is detected (6–8 ft range).

Plug & Play Operation – Just insert a microSD card and plug the camera into a power socket or power bank to start recording instantly. Note: Supports FAT32-formatted microSD cards – Minimum 16GB, maximum 256GB. (SD card not included)
Easy Video Access – View recordings on your PC/laptop using the included USB cable, or on your smartphone via an OTG adapter (not included).
100% Private Recording – No data transfer to cloud servers. Only you have access to the recorded content on your SD card.
Mobile Charging Function – Eye4spy USB Charger Camera Also works as a real USB charger for smartphones and other devices – an added convenience!
6-Month Warranty – Covers manufacturing defects. Excludes accessories, wear & tear, or misuse. Proof of purchase required for warranty claim.
description: The Eye4spy 1080P USB Charger Camera is a compact, discreet surveillance solution designed for home, office, or shop security. Disguised as a functional USB charger, this device captures crystal-clear 1080P HD video with a 70° wide-angle lens, ensuring thorough coverage without drawing attention. With two recording modes—continuous and motion-based—the camera offers flexibility based on your needs. Motion detection triggers recording when movement is sensed within 6–8 feet, helping conserve storage. Loop recording ensures uninterrupted coverage by automatically overwriting the oldest files when the microSD card is full (supports up to 256GB; SD card not included). The camera is easy to use—just plug and play. No Wi-Fi, no apps, no monthly fees, and no cloud – ensuring complete data privacy. Recorded videos can be viewed directly on a PC or laptop using the included USB cable. Whether for monitoring nannies, securing your workspace, or discreet home protection, this USB charger camera offers a seamless and effective security solution—all while functioning as a real USB charger.
